ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Certify Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Certify a tool for Active Directory certificate abuse based on PE metadata characteristics and common command line arguments.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\Certify\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Certify\.exe" OR process_description = RGX(".*Certify.*")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ cas\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ find\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ pkiobjects\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ request\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ download\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/vulnerable.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/template\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/altname\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/domain\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/path\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/ca\\:.*")))
